claim.name: constellation-net
claim.label: Stars
claim.description: A living constellation — drifting star motes linked by hairline light when they near each other, the net breathing as stars wander.

claim.name: pointer-spark-trail
claim.label: Emission
claim.description: The cursor strikes flint — hot sparks shear off its path, arcing down on gravity and cooling from white to brass to ash as they die.

claim.name: click-burst
claim.label: Motes
claim.description: Engage and a ring of brass motes detonates outward — one clean radial burst that decelerates, twinkles, and dies like a struck match head.

claim.name: flow-ribbon
claim.label: Flow speed
claim.description: A silk ribbon of light particles streams across the scene on an invisible current, folding and relaxing like smoke drawn in one line.

claim.name: sdf-metablob
claim.label: Blobs
claim.description: A molten brass blob breathes at the heart of the tile — satellite droplets orbit in, fuse seamlessly through liquid necks, then pinch free again.

claim.name: hyperspace-warp
claim.label: Warp Speed
claim.description: The stars jump to lightspeed — a tunnel of streaks stretching radially from the vanishing point, surging in waves like an engine spooling.

claim.name: orbit-trails
claim.label: Bodies
claim.description: A miniature orrery of light — bright bodies sweeping elliptical orbits, each dragging a fading arc of its own path behind it.

claim.name: sand-pile
claim.label: Grain rate
claim.description: Brass grains rain down and build a growing dune grain by grain, then a gust sweeps it clean and it begins again.

claim.name: bokeh-drift
claim.label: Discs
claim.description: Out-of-focus lights drift across a lens — big soft aperture discs in warm amber and ice, swelling and melting through each other in dreamy parallax.

claim.name: image-to-particles
claim.label: Grain Density
claim.description: The card disintegrates into a storm of grains that carry its actual colors, swirl away, then fly home to reassemble it perfectly.

claim.name: comet-orbit
claim.label: Eccentricity
claim.description: A single comet rounds the tile on a long ellipse — an ice-bright head trailing a fire tail that streams away from the sun, flaring at perihelion and ghosting at the far turn.
